criteria.description: Expose and invoke the exact Trade-based classifier and three result values.
checks: Return exactly ASSET_LEVEL, SETTLEMENT_LEVEL, or NOT_TOKENISED.

criteria.description: A tokenised bond is classified at asset level.
checks: The fixture is a bond/security, not a native cryptocurrency substituted for the requested case.

criteria.description: A conventional Gilt repo with tokenised cash settlement is settlement-level only.
checks: The result is SETTLEMENT_LEVEL and an explicit negative assertion excludes ASSET_LEVEL.

criteria.description: A conventional Gilt with conventional settlement is not tokenised.
Traverse the exact CDM 7.0.0 repo product topology rather than a plausible fixture invented by the implementation.
checks: Exercise a version-correct repo with the top-level interest-rate payout and purchased asset in the nested collateral product.
Prove the economic leaf used by the classifier is present before asserting the result.

criteria.description: Asset-level tokenisation takes precedence when both asset and settlement signals exist.
checks: A repo whose correctly nested purchased asset is tokenised returns ASSET_LEVEL even when settlement is also tokenised.

criteria.description: Represent facts missing from CDM 7.0.0 through a narrow explicit application seam.
checks: Keep Trade as the public input.
Do not misuse DigitalAsset for a digital representation of another asset.
Document which token or transfer evidence is application-owned and how it is keyed.

criteria.description: Tests exercise the requested API and prove their fixtures are economically meaningful.
checks: Invoke the exact entry point in a focused test.
Include a close negative and a non-vacuous fixture-shape assertion.
